facts.text: KC3405P is the class of the Korad KC3405 power supply controlled over Ethernet
KC3405P opens a UDP socket and binds it to the configured port (constructor default 18190)
_send_command sends the command followed by CRLF over the UDP socket
get_device_info queries ':SYST:DEVINFO?' and reads eight reply lines into a dictionary
get_status reads 'STATUS?' and maps its bits to CV/CC mode and on/off output for channels 1 to 4
The measured voltage and current are queried with VOUT<channel>? and IOUT<channel>?
The voltage and current setpoints are queried with VSET<channel>? and ISET<channel>?
set_voltage writes VSET<channel>:<value> with three decimals and verifies the readback within 0.01 V
set_current writes ISET<channel>:<value> with three decimals and verifies the readback within 0.01 A
enable_output(0) writes OUT1234:1 and disable_output(0) writes OUT1234:0; a channel number writes OUT<channel>:1 or OUT<channel>:0
The overcurrent protection setting is read with OCPSET<channel>? and written with OCPSET<channel>:<value>
The overvoltage protection setting is read with OVPSET<channel>? and written with OVPSET<channel>:<value>
OCP<channel>? reads the overcurrent protection state; OCP<channel>:1 and OCP<channel>:0 enable and disable it
OVP<channel>? reads the overvoltage protection state; OVP<channel>:1 and OVP<channel>:0 enable and disable it
get_settings reads the device information, the status and, for each channel 1 to 4, the protection settings and states, the voltage and current setpoints and the measured voltage and current
The clone's _check_channel states that a channel must be between 1 and 4
get_settings iterates the channels with range(1, 5)
